notes.drawing: After the maintainer's reference and the diagonal of batch-6 direction C, with fewer details: a bow arc (sagitta 64 over a string 184 long) bulging to the upper right, a straight string from (34.35,91.55) to (164.45,221.65), and an arrow from (40,216) to (216,40) crossing the string at its middle, with a chevron head (arms 48) and one chevron of fletching (arms 30 at 40 degrees).
notes.string: The string is drawn one weight lighter than the bow, as the maintainer asked, with a nested stroke-width the build keeps: light.svg (bow 12, string 8), regular.svg (16 / 12), bold.svg (24 / 16), and in fill.svg at 12. Thin keeps both at 8 (line.svg, no override): a 6-unit string (tried) is a 0.4 px line at 16 px and nearly disappears in an inactive grey, and Phosphor has no stroke lighter than 8.
notes.fill: Bow and shaft at 16, string at 12, head and fletching as solid triangles, as Phosphor's arrow fills do.
notes.duotone: The space between bow and string is tinted.
notes.phosphorPlanned: Phosphor's maintainer wrote on 2026-11-24 that bow-and-arrow is slated for their next release; when theirs ships, this one gets deprecated.
